quality.title: Pre-dispatch photos
quality.intro: Optional. Share photos of the goods before you dispatch. An automatic check compares them with the order and keeps the result as advisory evidence in case of a dispute. It is not an approval and never blocks dispatch or payment.
quality.limitReached: You have shared the maximum number of photo sets for this order.
quality.onlyBeforeDispatch: Photos can only be shared before or at dispatch.
quality.pendingRefresh: Analysing your photos. This page updates automatically.
quality.privacy: Location and camera details are removed from photos before they are stored. Photos are private and deleted after 6 months.

errors.format: Use JPEG, PNG or WebP photos.
errors.maxPhotos: You can add up to {max} photos.
errors.shareFailed: We could not share your photos. Please try again.

video.help: Optional. Up to {seconds} seconds and {mb} MB. Your phone picks {min} to {max} still frames from it; only those frames are uploaded, never the video.
video.picked: Picked {count} frames from your video. Check them, then share.

errors.format: Choose a video file (MP4, MOV or WebM).
errors.tooLarge: That video is larger than {mb} MB.
errors.tooLong: That video is longer than {seconds} seconds.
errors.unreadable: We could not read that video on this device. Try photos instead.
errors.noFrames: We could not pick enough frames from that video. Try photos instead.

quality.videoIntroExtra: You can also share a short video instead of photos.
